sources.content: # .cursorrules for Jettlemark. Jettlemark is a Python 3.12 library that wraps several card payment gateways behind one interface. Install dev dependencies with `uv sync --dev`. Run tests with `uv run pytest`; tests that hit a gateway sandbox are marked `@pytest.mark.live` and skipped unless `JTM_LIVE=1` is set. Gateway adapters live in `src/jettlemark/gateways/`, one module per gateway. Type checking uses mypy in strict mode through `uv run mypy src`. The shared interface is the `Gateway` protocol in `src/jettlemark/base.py`.

Money rules. Store every amount as an integer count of the smallest currency unit, never as a float. Currency codes are three-letter ISO 4217 strings in uppercase. Every call that creates a charge must pass an idempotency key; adapters reject calls without one. Never write card numbers to logs; the logging filter in `src/jettlemark/redact.py` masks all but the last 4 digits. Retries on network errors stop after 3 attempts, with exponential backoff starting at 200 milliseconds.

claims.text: Jettlemark retries network errors up to 5 times.
Jettlemark tests marked live are skipped unless JTM_LIVE=1 is set.
Jettlemark adapters reject charge calls that lack an idempotency key.
Jettlemark stores amounts as integers in the smallest currency unit.
Jettlemark gateway adapters live in src/jettlemark/adapters/.
Jettlemark's logging filter masks all but the last 4 digits of card numbers.
